assets.prompt: Edit target: attached Kraken image. Create a production-ready isolated CREATURE ONLY PNG cutout, with a genuinely transparent alpha background. Preserve this exact Kraken identity: purple/navy armored mantle swept upward to the right, narrow hostile glowing cyan eyes, central hooked chitin beak, jagged pale barnacle-encrusted armor and spurs, thick curling muscular tentacles with teal luminous suckers, richly shaded crisp fantasy RPG pixel-art style. Preserve the reference's closed beak face (not the later huge open circular mouth). Include the entire head and all visible tentacles with 5% clear margin on every side. Carefully reconstruct the bottoms of the limbs previously hidden in water so tentacles end in complete organic tips resting along a coherent lower footprint. Keep its broad three-quarter pose, intimidating expression, moonlit edges and purple-teal lighting, with no new anatomical redesign. Remove EVERYTHING other than the creature: ocean, sky, moon, lightning, rocks, ruins, water splashes, ground shadows, fog, and scenery. No base, no circular plinth, no text, no UI, no checkerboard painted into the image. High-quality transparent game boss asset, one still pose, not a sprite sheet.

Use the attached image only as a STYLE, COLOR, LIGHTING and ENVIRONMENT reference. Generate a standalone BACKGROUND LAYER for a 16:9 fantasy RPG Kraken battle arena. Remove the Kraken entirely; no creatures, people, ships, platforms, foreground props or UI. A moonlit storm-tossed ocean stretching to the horizon at about 42% of the image height. Large cool white-cyan full moon in upper left behind turbulent midnight navy clouds; distant jagged sea cliffs and small ancient ruined stone arches along far left and far right edges, subdued occasional lightning far right. Lower half is uninterrupted dark blue water with restrained horizontal teal moon reflections and low rolling wave patterns, deliberately quiet so a separate ship deck and sprites can be overlaid. Match reference's detailed crisp pixel-art rendering, purple/navy/teal palette, cool rim lighting and ominous fantasy atmosphere. Clear three-quarter side-view game camera, very slightly looking down toward the water, not overhead. No dominant large foreground waves or rocks, keep center and lower-middle uncluttered. Complete opaque edge-to-edge background, landscape 16:9 composition, no text, no labels, no watermark.

Use attached image ONLY as a pixel-art style and cool moonlighting reference; DO NOT include its creature or landscape. Rightmost 30% stays just as flat and clear as the left so a huge Kraken sprite can rest there; left and middle have abundant uncluttered floor space for 30 small hero sprites. No raised tiers, no central props, no masts, no ropes crossing the battle area, no cabin, no sails, no cannons, no characters, no Kraken. Strong readable horizontal landing surface, suitable for characters aligned on a common floor. Detailed crisp pixel-art, subdued dark brown wood with indigo shadows, cool cyan moonlight from upper left and restrained purple reflections, reference-matching fantasy RPG style. Entire platform silhouette inside the canvas with narrow clear side margins. Outside the deck and tiny hull wake must remain completely transparent, not black, not a painted checkerboard. No sky, distant ocean, rocks or scenery baked in, no text/UI/watermark.

Use the attached Kraken image ONLY as reference for pixel-art style and moonlit navy/teal palette. Generate a SEPARATE FOREGROUND OVERLAY asset for a 16:9 fantasy RPG battle scene, with genuine transparent alpha. Match a moonlit ocean viewed slightly from above, composited in front of a broad low wooden ship deck whose front hull ends at about y=93% of the frame. All visible foreground art must be restricted to the BOTTOM 10% of the canvas, with a few small splash tips at the extreme left and right corners reaching no higher than the bottom 16%. Subject: a low narrow strip of close-up dark midnight-blue choppy waves with crisp pale teal moonlit foam crests, soft sparse spray specks only near lower corners, dark water shapes merging into transparent upper edge. Broad continuous wave band at bottom frame edge, slightly larger crests at far corners and a deliberately low calm center. No creature, no ship or deck, no planks, no rocks, no horizon, moon, clouds or background; no text or UI; not a complete opaque ocean illustration.
